provenance.attribution: Truth Harness scratch-reuse pilot, 2026-09-06. Original Lean encoding of a standard sequential evaluation recurrence; no imported Prove2Me contribution.

assumptions: The input is a finite binary tree, not a cyclic graph or a shared DAG requiring memoization.
Children are evaluated sequentially and their scratch regions are reused, not retained concurrently.
Each active level, including a leaf, costs at most frame units; retained outputs and bookkeeping must fit that frame.
Persistent storage is accounted for separately. The caller establishes height(tree) <= depth and persistent + frame * depth <= budget.
Arithmetic is unbounded Nat arithmetic. Machine overflow, allocator overhead, alignment, threads, I/O and runtime implementation correspondence are not verified.

nodes.formal_statement: (frame : Nat) (left right : Tree) : scratch frame (.branch left right) = frame + max (scratch frame left) (scratch frame right)
(frame left right depth : Nat) (hl : left <= frame * depth) (hr : right <= frame * depth) : frame + max left right <= frame * (depth + 1)
(frame : Nat) (tree : Tree) : scratch frame tree <= frame * height tree
(persistent frame depth budget : Nat) (tree : Tree) (hd : height tree <= depth) (hb : persistent + frame * depth <= budget) : persistent + scratch frame tree <= budget
